get_benefit.description: Read one company benefit, with its contribution rule - a fixed amount, a percentage, or a tiered schedule.
get_benefit.name: get_benefit

parameters.description: The benefit to read. Pick one, or paste a Finch benefit ID.
parameters.name: benefit_id

get_benefit_enrollments.description: Read each person's own settings for one benefit - how much they contribute, the company's match, any annual maximum, and whether catch-up contributions apply. Leave the individual IDs empty to read everyone enrolled.
get_benefit_enrollments.name: get_benefit_enrollments

parameters.description: The benefit to read. Pick one, or paste a Finch benefit ID.
parameters.name: benefit_id

parameters.description: Only read these people's settings. Leave empty for everyone enrolled in the benefit.
parameters.name: individual_ids

benefit_id.description: The benefit these settings are for

enrollments.description: Each person's settings for this benefit

errors.description: IDs Finch could not answer for, with its reason

get_company.description: Read the employer's own record: legal name, EIN, entity type and subtype, departments, work locations, and the bank accounts payroll is funded from. Takes no input - it describes whichever employer this connection is for.
get_company.display_str_template: Get the company record from Finch.
get_company.name: get_company

get_employments.description: Read employment records for the individuals named - job title, employment type and status, start and end dates, manager, department, work location, and current and historical pay rates. IDs Finch cannot resolve come back under 'errors' while the rest still return.
get_employments.name: get_employments

parameters.description: Finch individual IDs to look up. Accepts a list, a single ID, or the records from a 'List directory' step - their 'id' is read for you.
parameters.name: individual_ids

employments.description: The employment records Finch could resolve

errors.description: IDs Finch could not answer for, with its reason

get_individuals.description: Read personal profiles for the individuals named - preferred name, date of birth, home address, emails and phone numbers. Finch answers each ID separately, so IDs it cannot resolve come back under 'errors' while the rest still return.
get_individuals.name: get_individuals

parameters.description: Finch individual IDs to look up. Accepts a list, a single ID, or the records from a 'List directory' step - their 'id' is read for you.
parameters.name: individual_ids

parameters.description: Sensitive fields to include. Finch redacts a social security number unless it is asked for by name, and only returns it if this connection is scoped for it.
parameters.name: include

errors.description: IDs Finch could not answer for, with its reason

get_job_status.description: Read one data-sync job: whether it is pending, running, complete or failed, and when it ran. Use it to wait for a sync to finish before reading payroll data that depends on it.
get_job_status.display_str_template: Get a Finch data sync job.
get_job_status.name: get_job_status

parameters.description: The job to read, from a 'List data sync jobs' step.
parameters.name: job_id

get_pay_group.description: Read one pay group, with the IDs of everyone in it and how often it is paid.
get_pay_group.name: get_pay_group

parameters.description: The pay group to read. Pick one, or paste a Finch pay group ID.
parameters.name: pay_group_id

get_pay_statements.description: Read the per-employee pay statements behind one or more payroll runs: every earning, tax, employee deduction and employer contribution, with the employer's own name for each line alongside Finch's normalised type. Amounts are in the currency's minor units, so 276900 is $2,769.00.
get_pay_statements.name: get_pay_statements

parameters.description: Finch payment IDs, from a 'List payments' step. Accepts a list, a single ID, or that step's records.
parameters.name: payment_ids

parameters.description: How many records to return, 1-1000. Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before this page. Use the 'next_offset' from a previous run to read the following page.
parameters.name: offset

errors.description: IDs Finch could not answer for, with its reason

pay_statements.description: One group of pay statements per payroll run

pending.description: IDs whose data Finch is still fetching from the provider; these usually succeed on a later run

pending_count.description: How many IDs are still syncing

introspect_connection.description: Read what this connection actually is: which employer and payroll provider it points at, and which products it was authorised for. Start here when another step fails with a permission error - 'products' is the authoritative list of what this token may read.
introspect_connection.name: introspect_connection

list_automated_jobs.description: List the data-sync jobs Finch has run for this connection, most recent first, with the status of each. A 'reauth_error' or 'permissions_error' here is why other steps started returning stale or empty data - both mean the employer has to reconnect.
list_automated_jobs.name: list_automated_jobs

parameters.description: How many records to return, 1-1000. Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before this page. Use the 'next_offset' from a previous run to read the following page.
parameters.name: offset

jobs.description: Data sync jobs for this connection

next_offset.description: The 'offset' that reads the next page

total_count.description: Records matching in total, when Finch reports one

list_benefits.description: List every benefit the employer offers, with its normalised type, the employer's own description of it, how often it is deducted, and the company's contribution rule.
list_benefits.name: list_benefits

total_count.description: Records matching in total, when Finch reports one

list_directory.description: List everyone in the employer's directory - name, department, manager and whether they are currently active - a page at a time. This is the index: use the IDs it returns with 'Get individuals' or 'Get employments' to read someone's detail.
list_directory.name: list_directory

parameters.description: How many records to return, 1-1000. Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before this page. Use the 'next_offset' from a previous run to read the following page.
parameters.name: offset

individuals.description: Everyone on this page of the directory

next_offset.description: The 'offset' that reads the next page

total_count.description: Records matching in total, when Finch reports one

list_enrolled_individuals.description: List the IDs of everyone enrolled in one benefit. Pair it with 'Get individuals' to put names to them, or with 'Get benefit enrollments' for each person's own contribution settings.
list_enrolled_individuals.display_str_template: List who is enrolled in a Finch benefit.
list_enrolled_individuals.name: list_enrolled_individuals

parameters.description: The benefit to read. Pick one, or paste a Finch benefit ID.
parameters.name: benefit_id

list_pay_groups.description: List the employer's pay groups and how often each is paid. Filter to the groups one person belongs to, or to particular pay frequencies. Not every payroll provider reports pay groups; an empty list means this one does not.
list_pay_groups.name: list_pay_groups

parameters.description: Only return the pay groups this person belongs to. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: individual_id

parameters.description: Only return groups paid this often.
parameters.name: pay_frequencies

total_count.description: Records matching in total, when Finch reports one

list_pay_statement_items.description: List the distinct earnings, taxes, deductions and employer contributions this employer's payroll actually uses - the catalogue of line items, not any one person's amounts. This is what to read before mapping a payroll into another system.
list_pay_statement_items.name: list_pay_statement_items

parameters.description: Only return items in these categories.
parameters.name: categories

parameters.description: Only include items seen on pay statements from this date onwards.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Only include items seen on pay statements up to this date.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Only return items the employer calls this, such as 'Regular' or '401(k)'.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Only return items of this normalised Finch type, such as 'salary' or '401k'.
parameters.name: item_type

items.description: The line items this employer's payroll uses

total_count.description: Records matching in total, when Finch reports one

list_payments.description: List the employer's payroll runs whose pay date falls in a date range, with gross and net pay, employee and employer taxes, the company debit, and the pay period each covers. Both dates are required - Finch refuses an unbounded query. Use the payment IDs with 'Get pay statements' for per-person detail.
list_payments.name: list_payments

parameters.description: Earliest pay date to include, inclusive.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Latest pay date to include, inclusive.
parameters.name: end_date

payments.description: Payroll runs in the date range

total_count.description: Records matching in total, when Finch reports one

list_providers.description: List every payroll and HR system Finch can connect to, with the products each supports and how it authenticates. This is Finch's own catalogue rather than anything about the current connection, so it answers the same whichever employer is connected - useful for checking coverage before asking one to connect.
list_providers.display_str_template: List the systems Finch can connect to.
list_providers.name: list_providers

total_count.description: Records matching in total, when Finch reports one

list_supported_benefits.description: List which benefit types this employer's payroll provider supports through Finch, and what may be set on each - the frequencies allowed, the deduction and contribution styles, and whether annual maximums and catch-up contributions apply. Support varies by provider, and this is the only endpoint that says so.
list_supported_benefits.display_str_template: List the benefit types Finch supports here.
list_supported_benefits.name: list_supported_benefits

total_count.description: Records matching in total, when Finch reports one

description: Read employment data from any payroll or HR system through one connection - the company, the employee directory, individual and employment records, payroll runs and pay statements, pay groups and the benefits an employer offers.
